title: Resetting Your Password
content: To reset your password, visit the login page and click on 'Forgot Password'. Follow the link sent to your email to set a new password. You can also change it within the app under **Settings > Security > Change Password**.

title: Refund Policy Overview
content: We offer a full refund if requested within **7 days** of purchase. To request a refund, contact our support team with your order ID. Note that digital goods are non-refundable once the license key has been activated.

title: Tracking Your Order
content: You can track your order in real-time by visiting the **'Orders'** section of your dashboard. Once an item is shipped, a tracking number will be provided via email.

title: Subscription Plans
content:
We offer three plans: 
1. **Basic**: $10/mo for standard features.
2. **Pro**: $25/mo for advanced analytics and priority support.
3. **Enterprise**: Contact sales for custom pricing and dedicated account management.

title: Account Cancellation
content: Users can cancel their account at any time. Go to **Settings > Account > Manage Subscription** and select 'Cancel'. Your data will be retained for 30 days before permanent deletion.

title: Data Privacy & GDPR
content: We are fully GDPR compliant. You can request a copy of your data or ask for data deletion through our **Privacy Center** located in the footer of our website.

title: Contacting Support
content:
Our support team is available 24/7. Reach us via:
- **Email**: support@weitredge.ai
- **Live Chat**: Click the bubble in the bottom right corner.
- **Phone**: +1 (800) 123-4567 (9 AM - 6 PM EST)

title: Feature Requests
content: We value user feedback! Submit your feature requests on our public roadmap at `roadmap.weitredge.ai`. Other users can upvote your suggestions.
